sentence_stem: Not only did the manager explain the decision clearly,
correct_completion: but she also listened carefully to every objection.
full_sentence: Not only did the manager explain the decision clearly, but she also listened carefully to every objection.
acceptable_variants: but she also took the time to answer each concern.
but she also invited the team to share their doubts.

options.text: so the meeting ended early that day.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but the stem sets up an additive structure with 'not only ... but also', which needs a second positive action rather than a consequence.
'Although' introduces a contrast, but the 'not only ... but also' structure requires an additional action of the same kind, not a concession.

options.text: but she also listened carefully to every objection.
and the office was located on the third floor.
options.why_wrong: This adds a neutral detail, but it does not complete the 'not only ... but also' pair, which needs a second action by the manager.

grammar_focus: Correlative conjunctions 'not only ... but also' with subject-auxiliary inversion after 'not only'
explanation: After 'Not only did', the auxiliary moves before the subject, and the sentence needs an additive second clause introduced by 'but also' that presents a second action of similar weight. Speakers whose first language keeps the subject before the verb may omit this inversion, so it helps to practise it as a fixed pattern.
translation: Não só a gerente explicou a decisão com clareza, como também ouviu com atenção cada objeção.
